prompt:
A wide establishing vista of Beijing in a far-future cyberpunk world — environment key art for a game world map, with no people.

The place: Beijing two centuries from now, a far-future megacity: at its heart the old palace city kept exactly as it was, its vermilion walls and golden roofs glowing, and the long north-south axis through it extended for miles as a ribbon of light; around it the concentric ring roads turned into rings of light where quiet flying vehicles stream in circles, far-future towers of white ceramic and jade-green glass rising ring after ring; the round temple hall with its three tiers of deep-blue roofs glowing above a floating garden; on the mountain ridges to the north the ancient crenellated wall kept as it was, every watchtower passing a pulse of vermilion light to the next ridge, under a clear, deep night sky.

Composition: a sweeping view from a high vantage point at a three-quarter angle, layered depth — framing elements in the near foreground, the city spread across the middle ground, mountains and sky far behind. The whole city reads at a glance as one memorable skyline. Keep the lower quarter of the picture calm and slightly darker (water, terrace or treetops without detail clutter) so interface cards can sit over it.

Style: painterly environment key art matching Korean MMORPG character artwork — 2D painting with visible brushwork, layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, a few crisp accents; rich atmospheric perspective and luminous light.

No people, no characters, no animals in focus; no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermark; no frame or border.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.
